name: io.github.Pyrochem/universal-quant-tournament-mcp
description: 8-Strategy Quant Tournament & Monte Carlo Risk Gate with Native MT5 & Alpaca Execution.

environmentVariables.name: RAPIDAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RapidAPI Key for Universal Quant Strategy Tournament (Free Tier: 9 calls/mo at https://rapidapi.com/infio-infio-default/api/universal-quant-strategy-tournament). Omit for Zero-Key Sandbox Preview.

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Alpaca API Key ID (starts with PK for Paper or AK for Live) for direct US Equity & Crypto execution.

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Alpaca API Secret Key for direct US Equity & Crypto execution.

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_PAPER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' for Alpaca Paper Trading (default) or 'false' for Live Trading.
